receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.subtitle: Money received from customers, set against their open bills. The rest stays on account.
receipts.noCompanyBody: Admin adds the company first on Companies.
receipts.noRight: Recording receipts needs the “Cash book · create” or “Receipts and payments · create” right. Ask Admin.

entry.title: Record a receipt
entry.noCustomers: No customers for this company yet
entry.noAccount: No account of this kind yet · Admin adds it on Bank
entry.cashRule: Cash from one person in a day is limited by the Income-tax rule; the server refuses a receipt that reaches the limit set on Settings.

bills.title: Open bills of this customer
bills.chooseFirst: Choose a customer to see their open bills.
bills.emptyBody: Everything is settled; the whole amount will stay on account.

err.noCash: There is no cash account yet.
err.noBank: There is no bank account yet.
err.amount: Enter the amount in rupees, up to 2 decimals.
err.allocFormat: Allocations are rupees with up to 2 decimals.
err.allocOver: The allocations add up to more than the amount.
err.reason: Write a reason of at least 5 characters.

reverseDlg.title: Reverse receipt {{no}}?
reverseDlg.effect: A reversal entry for ₹{{amount}} is posted and the bills it settled are open again. The receipt is never edited or deleted.
